005package org.wpilib.hardware.expansionhub;
006
007import java.util.OptionalInt;
008import org.wpilib.framework.RobotBase;
009import org.wpilib.networktables.BooleanSubscriber;
010import org.wpilib.networktables.NetworkTableInstance;
011import org.wpilib.system.SystemServer;
012import org.wpilib.system.Timer;
013import org.wpilib.util.UsageReporting;
014
015/** This class controls a REV ExpansionHub plugged in over USB to Systemcore. */
016public class ExpansionHub implements AutoCloseable {
017  private static class DataStore implements AutoCloseable {
018    private final int m_usbId;
019    private int m_refCount;
020    private int m_reservedMotorMask;
021    private int m_reservedServoMask;
022    private final Object m_reserveLock = new Object();
023
024    private final OptionalInt[] followerConfiguration = new OptionalInt[4];
025    private final int[] followerVisited = new int[4];
026
027    private final BooleanSubscriber m_hubConnectedSubscriber;
028
029    DataStore(int usbId) {
030      m_usbId = usbId;
031      m_storeMap[usbId] = this;
032
033      NetworkTableInstance systemServer = SystemServer.getSystemServer();
034
035      m_hubConnectedSubscriber =
036          systemServer.getBooleanTopic("/rhsp/" + usbId + "/connected").subscribe(false);
037
038      for (int i = 0; i < followerConfiguration.length; i++) {
039        followerConfiguration[i] = OptionalInt.empty();
040      }
041
042      // Wait up to half a second for connected to come up, using a poll loop to
043      // ensure we don't block.
044      if (RobotBase.isReal()) {
045        double startTime = Timer.getMonotonicTimestamp();
046        while (Timer.getMonotonicTimestamp() - startTime < 0.5) {
047          if (m_hubConnectedSubscriber.get(false)) {
048            break;
049          }
050          Timer.delay(0.01);
051        }
052      }
053    }
054
055    @Override
056    public void close() {
057      m_storeMap[m_usbId] = null;
058    }
059
060    public void addRef() {
061      m_refCount++;
062    }
063
064    public void removeRef() {
065      m_refCount--;
066      if (m_refCount == 0) {
067        this.close();
068      }
069    }
070  }
071
072  private static final DataStore[] m_storeMap = new DataStore[4];
073
074  private static void checkUsbId(int usbId) {
075    if (usbId < 0 || usbId > 3) {
076      throw new IllegalArgumentException("USB Port " + usbId + " out of range");
077    }
078  }
079
080  private static DataStore getForUsbId(int usbId) {
081    checkUsbId(usbId);
082    synchronized (m_storeMap) {
083      DataStore store = m_storeMap[usbId];
084      if (store == null) {
085        store = new DataStore(usbId);
086      }
087      store.addRef();
088      return store;
089    }
090  }
091
092  private static void freeHub(DataStore store) {
093    synchronized (m_storeMap) {
094      store.removeRef();
095    }
096  }
097
098  private final DataStore m_dataStore;
099
100  /**
101   * Constructs a new ExpansionHub for a given USB ID.
102   *
103   * <p>Multiple instances can be constructed, but will point to the same backing object with a ref
104   * count.
105   *
106   * @param usbId The USB Port ID the hub is plugged into.
107   */
108  public ExpansionHub(int usbId) {
109    m_dataStore = getForUsbId(usbId);
110  }
111
112  /**
113   * Closes an ExpansionHub object. Will not close any other instances until the last instance is
114   * closed.
115   */
116  @Override
117  public void close() {
118    freeHub(m_dataStore);
119  }
120
121  boolean checkServoChannel(int channel) {
122    return channel >= 0 && channel < 6;
123  }
124
125  boolean checkAndReserveServo(int channel) {
126    int mask = 1 << channel;
127    synchronized (m_dataStore.m_reserveLock) {
128      if ((m_dataStore.m_reservedServoMask & mask) != 0) {
129        return false;
130      }
131      m_dataStore.m_reservedServoMask |= mask;
132      return true;
133    }
134  }
135
136  void unreserveServo(int channel) {
137    int mask = 1 << channel;
138    synchronized (m_dataStore.m_reserveLock) {
139      m_dataStore.m_reservedServoMask &= ~mask;
140    }
141  }
142
143  boolean checkMotorChannel(int channel) {
144    return channel >= 0 && channel < 4;
145  }
146
147  boolean checkAndReserveMotor(int channel) {
148    int mask = 1 << channel;
149    synchronized (m_dataStore.m_reserveLock) {
150      if ((m_dataStore.m_reservedMotorMask & mask) != 0) {
151        return false;
152      }
153      m_dataStore.m_reservedMotorMask |= mask;
154      return true;
155    }
156  }
157
158  void unreserveMotor(int channel) {
159    int mask = 1 << channel;
160    synchronized (m_dataStore.m_reserveLock) {
161      m_dataStore.followerConfiguration[channel] = OptionalInt.empty();
162      m_dataStore.m_reservedMotorMask &= ~mask;
163    }
164  }
165
166  void reportUsage(String device, String data) {
167    UsageReporting.reportUsage("ExpansionHub[" + m_dataStore.m_usbId + "]/" + device, data);
168  }
169
170  void reportUsage(String device, int instanceNumber, String data) {
171    UsageReporting.reportUsage(
172        "ExpansionHub[" + m_dataStore.m_usbId + "]/" + device, instanceNumber, data);
173  }
174
175  /**
176   * Constructs a servo at the requested channel on this hub.
177   *
178   * <p>Only a single instance of each servo per hub can be constructed at a time.
179   *
180   * @param channel The servo channel
181   * @return Servo object
182   */
183  public ExpansionHubServo makeServo(int channel) {
184    return new ExpansionHubServo(m_dataStore.m_usbId, channel);
185  }
186
187  /**
188   * Constructs a continuous rotation servo at the requested channel on this hub.
189   *
190   * <p>Only a single instance of each servo per hub can be constructed at a time.
191   *
192   * @param channel The servo channel
193   * @return Continuous rotation servo object
194   */
195  public ExpansionHubCRServo makeCRServo(int channel) {
196    return new ExpansionHubCRServo(m_dataStore.m_usbId, channel);
197  }
198
199  /**
200   * Constructs a motor at the requested channel on this hub.
201   *
202   * <p>Only a single instance of each motor per hub can be constructed at a time.
203   *
204   * @param channel The motor channel
205   * @return Motor object
206   */
207  public ExpansionHubMotor makeMotor(int channel) {
208    return new ExpansionHubMotor(m_dataStore.m_usbId, channel);
209  }
210
211  /**
212   * Gets if the hub is currently connected over USB.
213   *
214   * @return True if hub connection, otherwise false
215   */
216  public boolean isHubConnected() {
217    return m_dataStore.m_hubConnectedSubscriber.get(false);
218  }
219
220  private String getFollowerStringCycle(int baseChannel, int[] followerVisited) {
221    StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
222    sb.append(baseChannel);
223    int current = baseChannel;
224    while (followerVisited[current] != baseChannel) {
225      current = followerVisited[current];
226      sb.append(" -> ").append(current);
227    }
228    sb.append(" -> ").append(followerVisited[current]);
229    return sb.toString();
230  }
231
232  private void validateRootFollower(int baseChannel, int channel, int[] followerVisited) {
233    if (followerVisited[channel] != -1) {
234      throw new IllegalStateException(
235          "Follower cycle detected on hub "
236              + m_dataStore.m_usbId
237              + ": "
238              + getFollowerStringCycle(baseChannel, followerVisited));
239    }
240    OptionalInt leader = m_dataStore.followerConfiguration[channel];
241    if (leader.isEmpty()) {
242      return;
243    }
244    followerVisited[channel] = leader.getAsInt();
245    validateRootFollower(baseChannel, leader.getAsInt(), followerVisited);
246  }
247
248  private void validateFollowerConfiguration() {
249    for (int i = 0; i < m_dataStore.followerConfiguration.length; i++) {
250      for (int j = 0; j < m_dataStore.followerVisited.length; j++) {
251        m_dataStore.followerVisited[j] = -1;
252      }
253      validateRootFollower(i, i, m_dataStore.followerVisited);
254    }
255  }
256
257  void addFollower(int leaderChannel, int followerChannel) {
258    synchronized (m_dataStore.m_reserveLock) {
259      m_dataStore.followerConfiguration[followerChannel] = OptionalInt.of(leaderChannel);
260      validateFollowerConfiguration();
261    }
262  }
263
264  void removeFollower(int followerChannel) {
265    synchronized (m_dataStore.m_reserveLock) {
266      m_dataStore.followerConfiguration[followerChannel] = OptionalInt.empty();
267    }
268  }
269
270  /**
271   * Gets the USB ID of this hub.
272   *
273   * @return The USB ID
274   */
275  public int getUsbId() {
276    return m_dataStore.m_usbId;
277  }
278}
